title: Androgen receptor activation stabilizes a hybrid epithelial/mesenchymal phenotype in presence of Notch-Jagged signaling.
authors: Guha, Souvik; R, Soundharya; Tikader, Baishakhi; Kumar Jolly, Mohit
one_liner_zh: 该文构建前列腺癌中AR与Notch信号耦合的数学/多细胞模型，研究混合上皮间质表型，但核心是细胞信号网络而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Metastasis is a key cause of mortality in cancer. It is driven majorly by clusters of circulating tumor cells which are often comprised of cells in a hybrid epithelial/mesenchymal (E/M) phenotype. Hybrid E/M phenotype has also been shown to be more tumor-initiating and therapy-resistant, but how cells maintain the hybrid E/M phenotype(s) remains an active area of investigation. Here, we develop a mathematical model that couples the intracellular dynamics of key players of epithelial-mesenchymal transition with the androgen receptor (AR), and cell-cell communication through Notch-Delta-Jagged signaling, in the context of prostate cancer (PCa). Our simulations show that AR can stabilize a hybrid E/M phenotype predominantly in the presence of Notch-Jagged, but not Notch-Delta, signaling. Implementing this model on a multi-cellular lattice, we observed that AR can alter the fraction of cells exhibiting a hybrid E/M and a mesenchymal phenotype. Finally, through analysis of transcriptomic and patient survival data, we found that the co-expression of AR and Jagged correlated with worse outcomes. Together, these results highlight the outcome of emergent dynamics between the Notch and AR signaling axis in promoting PCa aggressiveness.
abstract_zh: 转移是癌症死亡的关键原因。它主要由循环肿瘤细胞簇驱动，这些细胞簇通常包含处于杂交上皮/间质（E/M）表型的细胞。杂交E/M表型也被证明更具肿瘤起始性和治疗抵抗性，但细胞如何维持杂交E/M表型仍是一个活跃的研究领域。在此，我们开发了一个数学模型，该模型将上皮-间质转化关键因子的细胞内动态与雄激素受体（AR）以及通过Notch-Delta-Jagged信号传导的细胞间通讯相结合，在前列腺癌（PCa）背景下进行研究。我们的模拟显示，AR主要在存在Notch-Jagged（而非Notch-Delta）信号传导时，能稳定杂交E/M表型。将该模型应用于多细胞晶格上，我们观察到AR可以改变表现出杂交E/M和间质表型的细胞比例。最后，通过分析转录组和患者生存数据，我们发现AR和Jagged的共表达与较差预后相关。综合来看，这些结果突显了Notch和AR信号轴之间涌现动态在促进PCa侵袭性方面的结果。
